title: Mounting bracket (mechanical only)
goal: An aluminum L-bracket that mounts a 200 g camera to a 20 mm T-slot extrusion. It must survive 5x the static camera load with a safety factor >= 2.0, and keep mass under 60 g. Use the CAD tools to author and commit the bracket geometry, and validate it with FEA.

design: L-bracket geometry authored and committed to the twin as a viewable cad_model
material (aluminum grade) and wall thickness chosen with rationale
simulation: pass-fail verdict recorded against the SF>=2 requirement
